quote

The keys in the quote category control the arrangement and style of quote blocks.

Key Value Type Example

background-color

Color
(default: not set)

 
quote:
  background-color: #757575

border-color

Color
(default: 'EEEEEE')

 
quote:
  border-color: #E6E8FA

border-left-width

Measurement
(default: 4)

 
quote:
  border-left-width: 5

border-radius

Measurement
(default: not set)

 
quote:
  border-radius: 4

border-style

Border style
(default: solid)

 
quote:
  border-style: dotted

border-width

Measurement | Measurement[]
(default: 0)

 
quote:
  border-width: 0.5

font-color

Color
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  font-color: #333333

font-family

Font family name
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  font-family: Noto Serif

font-kerning

none | normal
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  font-kerning: none

font-size

Font size
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  font-size: 13

font-style

Font style
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  font-style: bold

padding

Measurement | Measurement[]
(default: [3, 12, 3, 14])

 
quote:
  padding: [3, 0, 3, 20]

text-transform

Text transform
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  text-transform: uppercase

border-width and border-left-width

If the value assigned to the border-left-width key is non-zero, the border is only applied to the left side of the quote block. Otherwise, if the value assigned to the border-width key is non-zero, the border is drawn around the whole quote block.

quote-cite

The keys in the quote-cite category control the arrangement and style of the citation in quote blocks.

Key Value Type Example

font-color

Color
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    font-color: #999999

font-family

Font family name
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    font-family: Noto Serif

font-kerning

none | normal
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    font-kerning: none

font-size

Font size
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    font-size: 9

font-style

Font style
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    font-style: bold

text-transform

Text transform
(default: inherit)

 
quote:
  cite:
    text-transform: smallcaps
